messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: I want to make some new brews, do you think you can give me some ingredients to work with?
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 我想调几种新酒,你能给我些材料让我试试吗?

messages.text: Many Thanks! I'll be sure to let you have the first taste as soon as it's done... at a discounted price of course.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 万分感谢! 做好后我一定让你第一个尝……当然是打折价。

messages.text: Hard times we are in. Take care!
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
